en: The Gambia, officially the Republic of The Gambia, as a country in West Africa
Its position as the smallest country on the African mainland, following the Gambia river
zh: 冈比亚正式称冈比亚共和国，是西非国家
沿冈比亚河延伸，是非洲大陆面积最小的国家

politics.zh: 冈比亚共和国是西非国家，沿冈比亚河两岸延伸，除西面濒临大西洋外三面被塞内加尔包围，是非洲大陆面积最小的国家，首都为班珠尔。1965年脱离英国独立，为英联邦成员国；1994年发生军事政变，此后长期由同一领导人执政，2017年在选举与地区压力下实现政权更替。
politics.en: The Gambia, officially the Republic of The Gambia, is a country in West Africa that follows the Gambia river, surrounded by Senegal on three sides and facing the Atlantic to the west, the smallest country on the African mainland, with Banjul as its capital. It became independent from Britain in 1965 as a Commonwealth member; a military coup in 1994 brought a long period of rule by one leader, and in 2017 a change of government took place after elections and regional pressure.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、旅游业与转口贸易为基础，花生、腰果与渔产品是重要出口品，旅游业沿大西洋海岸发展，侨汇与再出口贸易占经济比重较大。
economy.en: The economy rests on farming, tourism and re-export trade, with groundnuts, cashew nuts and fish products among the leading exports, tourism developing along the Atlantic coast, and remittances and re-exports forming a large share of the economy.

culture.zh: 冈比亚有曼丁哥、富拉、沃洛夫等族群，英语为官方语言而曼丁哥语与沃洛夫语广泛使用，科拉琴与口传史诗传统深厚，伊斯兰教与基督教社群并存。
culture.en: The Gambia is made up of Mandinka, Fula and Wolof communities among others, English is official while Mandinka and Wolof are widely spoken, the kora and oral epic traditions run deep, and Muslim and Christian communities coexist.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1965年独立、1982至1989年与塞内加尔的邦联、1994年军事政变，以及2017年的政权更替。
events.en: Key moments are independence in 1965, the confederation with Senegal from 1982 to 1989, the military coup of 1994 and the change of government in 2017. It has since held regular multi-party elections and a peaceful transfer of power.

value.en: It became independent from Britain in 1965.

en: Malawi, officially the Republic of Malawi, as a landlocked country in south-eastern Africa
Its borders with Zambia to the west, Tanzania to the north and Mozambique to the east and south
zh: 马拉维正式称马拉维共和国，是东南非内陆国家
西邻赞比亚，北接坦桑尼亚，东与南连莫桑比克

politics.zh: 马拉维共和国是东南非内陆国家，西邻赞比亚，北接坦桑尼亚，东与南连莫桑比克，首都为利隆圭。1964年脱离英国独立，此后长期由同一政党执政，1994年举行首次多党选举；国家沿马拉维湖延伸，是非洲人口密度较高的国家之一，农业为经济主体。
politics.en: Malawi, officially the Republic of Malawi, is a landlocked country in south-eastern Africa, bordered by Zambia to the west, Tanzania to the north and Mozambique to the east and south, with Lilongwe as its capital. It became independent from Britain in 1964 and was long governed by a single party before holding its first multi-party election in 1994; the country stretches along Lake Malawi and is among the more densely populated in Africa, with farming the mainstay of its economy.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、渔业与轻工业为基础，烟草、茶叶与蔗糖是主要出口品，马拉维湖提供渔业资源，制造业以农产品加工为主，对援助与进口依赖较大。
economy.en: The economy rests on farming, fishing and light industry, with tobacco, tea and sugar the leading exports, Lake Malawi providing fishery resources, manufacturing limited largely to agricultural processing, and a considerable dependence on aid and imports.

culture.zh: 马拉维有契瓦、通布卡、尧等族群，契瓦语与英语为官方语言，马拉维湖沿岸的渔村文化与鼓乐、舞蹈传统延续，基督教与伊斯兰教社群并存。
culture.en: Malawi is made up of Chewa, Tumbuka and Yao communities among others, Chichewa and English are official, the fishing villages along Lake Malawi keep their culture and drumming and dance traditions continue, and Christian and Muslim communities coexist.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1964年独立、1966年成为共和国、1994年首次多党选举，以及此后的政权更替与自然灾害应对。
events.en: Key moments are independence in 1964, the republic of 1966, the first multi-party election in 1994 and the changes of government and responses to natural disasters that followed. It has since held regular multi-party elections and several transfers of power.

value.en: It became independent from Britain in 1964.

en: Botswana, officially the Republic of Botswana, as a landlocked country in Southern Africa
Its topographically flat territory and its borders with South Africa, Namibia, Zambia and Zimbabwe
zh: 博茨瓦纳正式称博茨瓦纳共和国，是南部非洲内陆国家
地势平坦，邻南非、纳米比亚、赞比亚与津巴布韦

politics.zh: 博茨瓦纳共和国是南部非洲内陆国家，地势平坦，邻南非、纳米比亚、赞比亚与津巴布韦，首都为哈博罗内。1966年脱离英国保护国地位独立，此后长期保持多党选举与政权平稳更替，是非洲治理与经济增长记录较好的国家之一，钻石收入为国家财政提供主要来源。
politics.en: Botswana, officially the Republic of Botswana, is a landlocked country in Southern Africa with a largely flat territory, bordered by South Africa, Namibia, Zambia and Zimbabwe, and with Gaborone as its capital. It became independent from British protection in 1966 and has since maintained multi-party elections and peaceful transfers of power, one of the better records of governance and growth in Africa, with diamond revenue the main source of public finance.

economy.zh: 经济以钻石开采、畜牧业与旅游业为基础，钻石出口占出口收入的绝大部分，奥卡万戈三角洲与野生动物资源支撑旅游业，牛群养殖是传统产业。
economy.en: The economy rests on diamond mining, cattle raising and tourism, with diamond exports accounting for the great majority of export earnings, the Okavango delta and its wildlife supporting tourism, and cattle keeping the traditional industry.

culture.zh: 博茨瓦纳以茨瓦纳语与英语为通用语言，茨瓦纳人的kgotla议事传统影响政治文化，桑人（布须曼人）保留独特的狩猎采集传统，音乐与手工艺体现多族群特色。
culture.en: Setswana and English are the common languages of Botswana, the kgotla assembly tradition of the Tswana shapes its political culture, the San retain distinctive hunting and gathering traditions, and its music and crafts reflect its many communities.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1966年独立、1967年起钻石矿的开发、1990年代的区域调解角色，以及此后持续的选举与政权更替。
events.en: Key moments are independence in 1966, the development of diamond mines from 1967, its regional mediation role in the 1990s and the continuing elections and transfers of power since then. Its diamond revenue has funded education and infrastructure for decades.

value.en: It became independent from British protection in 1966.

value.zh: 钻石收入为国家财政主要来源。
value.en: Diamond revenue is the main source of public finance.

en: The Hashemite Kingdom of Iraq as the Iraqi state existing from 1932 to 1958
Its establishment under the Hashemite monarchy and its end in the revolution of 1958
zh: 伊拉克王国是1932至1958年存在的哈希姆王朝伊拉克国家

politics.zh: 伊拉克王国是1932至1958年存在的哈希姆王朝国家，1921年在英国支持下建立君主制，1932年获得名义独立并加入国际联盟，由费萨尔一世及其后裔统治。它在两次世界大战之间经历部落与民族主义运动，石油收入与英国影响交织；1958年自由军官发动革命，君主制被推翻，共和国成立。
politics.en: The Hashemite Kingdom of Iraq was the Iraqi state that existed from 1932 to 1958, established as a monarchy with British support in 1921, gaining nominal independence and joining the League of Nations in 1932 under Faisal I and his successors. Between the world wars it saw tribal and nationalist movements, with oil revenue and British influence intertwined; in 1958 free officers staged a revolution, the monarchy was overthrown and a republic proclaimed.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、石油开采与过境贸易为基础，底格里斯与幼发拉底河流域的灌溉农业是主要生计，1930年代起石油收入逐步重要，巴格达与巴士拉是商业中心。
economy.en: The economy rested on farming, oil extraction and transit trade, with irrigated agriculture in the Tigris and Euphrates valleys the main livelihood, oil revenue growing in importance from the 1930s, and Baghdad and Basra as centres of commerce.

culture.zh: 王国时期伊拉克的考古、教育与文学得到发展，巴格达大学与博物馆建立，阿拉伯民族主义与地方部落传统并存，诗人与艺术家在社会生活中影响广泛。
culture.en: In the period of the kingdom Iraqi archaeology, education and literature developed, the university and museum of Baghdad were founded, Arab nationalism existed alongside local tribal tradition, and poets and artists had wide influence in social life.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1921年建立君主制、1932年名义独立、1941年英国再度干预，以及1958年革命推翻君主制。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the monarchy in 1921, nominal independence in 1932, renewed British intervention in 1941 and the revolution of 1958 that overthrew the monarchy. Its oil revenue and army made it an important regional state before 1958.

value.en: The monarchy was established in 1921 and nominal independence came in 1932.
The revolution of 1958 overthrew the monarchy.

en: Eritrea, officially the State of Eritrea, as a country in the Horn of Africa region of East Africa
Its capital and largest city, Asmara, and its long Red Sea coastline
zh: 厄立特里亚正式称厄立特里亚国，是东非非洲之角国家
首都与最大城市为阿斯马拉，拥有漫长的红海海岸线

politics.zh: 厄立特里亚国是东非非洲之角国家，首都与最大城市为阿斯马拉，拥有漫长的红海海岸线，1993年经公投脱离埃塞俄比亚独立。它由人民阵线执政，长期未举行全国选举，实行国民服役制度；与埃塞俄比亚在1998至2000年发生边界战争，此后长期处于紧张状态并有大量人口外流。
politics.en: Eritrea, officially the State of Eritrea, is a country in the Horn of Africa region of East Africa, with Asmara as its capital and largest city and a long Red Sea coastline, becoming independent from Ethiopia after a referendum in 1993. It is governed by the People's Front, has long gone without national elections and maintains a system of national service; it fought a border war with Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000 and has since remained in a state of tension with substantial emigration.

economy.zh: 经济以农业、采矿与港口服务为基础，红海沿岸的马萨瓦与阿萨布是港口，金、铜与钾盐资源逐步开发，侨汇与 diaspora 收入对经济有重要作用。
economy.en: The economy rests on farming, mining and port services, with Massawa and Assab as Red Sea harbours, gold, copper and potash resources being developed, and remittances and diaspora income playing an important part. Its ports also serve as outlets for the trade of its neighbours.

culture.zh: 厄立特里亚有提格里尼亚、提格雷、阿法尔等九个族群，提格里尼亚语、阿拉伯语与英语并用，阿斯马拉的现代主义建筑被列为世界遗产，东正教、伊斯兰教与天主教社群并存。
culture.en: Eritrea is made up of nine communities including the Tigrinya, Tigre and Afar, with Tigrinya, Arabic and English all used, the modernist architecture of Asmara listed as World Heritage, and Orthodox, Muslim and Catholic communities coexisting.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1961年起独立战争、1993年公投独立、1998至2000年与埃塞俄比亚的边界战争，以及2018年和平协议的签署。
events.en: Key moments are the independence war from 1961, the referendum and independence of 1993, the border war with Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000 and the peace agreement signed in 2018. Its border dispute was finally settled by agreement in 2018.

value.zh: 1993年经公投脱离埃塞俄比亚独立。
value.en: It became independent from Ethiopia after a referendum in 1993.

en: The French Fifth Republic as the current republican system of government in France
Its establishment in 1958 under Charles de Gaulle and its stronger executive presidency
zh: 法兰西第五共和国是法国现行的共和政体
1958年在戴高乐主导下建立，总统权力加强

politics.zh: 法兰西第五共和国是法国现行的共和政体，1958年在戴高乐主导下依新宪法建立，设有强势的总统与两院议会。它结束了第四共和国的政府频繁更迭，通过总统直选与全民公投强化行政权力；1962年起总统由直接选举产生，此后经历左右共治与多次宪法改革，仍为欧盟核心成员国。
politics.en: The French Fifth Republic is France's current republican system of government, established in 1958 under Charles de Gaulle with a new constitution providing for a strong presidency and a two-chamber parliament. It ended the frequent changes of government of the Fourth Republic and strengthened the executive through direct presidential election and referendums; since 1962 the president has been elected directly, and after periods of cohabitation and several constitutional reforms it remains a core member of the European Union.

economy.zh: 经济以制造业、服务业、农业与航空航天、核能与奢侈品产业为基础，国家在经济中作用较强，巴黎是金融与商业中心，社会政策与劳动制度常引发争论。
economy.en: The economy rests on manufacturing, services, agriculture and the aerospace, nuclear and luxury goods industries, with the state playing a considerable role, Paris as the financial and commercial centre, and social and labour policy often a subject of debate.

culture.zh: 第五共和国时期法国文化政策强化，电影、文学与思想影响广泛，博物馆与图书馆体系扩展，地方文化得到重视，法语国家组织扩大影响。
culture.en: In the period of the Fifth Republic French cultural policy was strengthened, its cinema, literature and thought widely influential, its museums and libraries expanded, regional cultures given more attention, and the organisation of la Francophonie extended its reach.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1958年新宪法与第五共和国建立、1962年总统直选、1968年社会运动，以及此后的多次宪法改革与欧洲一体化进程。
events.en: Key moments are the new constitution and the creation of the Fifth Republic in 1958, direct presidential election in 1962, the social movement of 1968 and the constitutional reforms and European integration that followed. Its institutions have since been amended several times by referendum.

value.en: It was established by a new constitution in 1958.
Since 1962 the president has been elected directly.

en: The Jalayirid Sultanate, also called the Ilka dynasty, as a Mongol dynasty ruling in Iraq and western Persia
Its rule after the collapse of the Ilkhanate in the fourteenth century
zh: 札剌亦儿王朝又称伊尔卡王朝，是统治伊拉克与波斯西部的蒙古王朝

politics.zh: 札剌亦儿王朝又称伊尔卡王朝，是统治伊拉克与波斯西部的蒙古王朝，14世纪中叶在伊儿汗国瓦解后由札剌亦儿部贵族建立，以巴格达与桃里寺（大不里士）为都。它控制美索不达米亚与阿塞拜疆的农业与商路，与穆扎法尔王朝、帖木儿及黑羊王朝长期交战；15世纪初被黑羊王朝与帖木儿势力取代。
politics.en: The Jalayirid Sultanate, also called the Ilka dynasty, was a Mongol dynasty that ruled in Iraq and western Persia, established in the mid-fourteenth century by nobles of the Jalayir tribe after the collapse of the Ilkhanate, with Baghdad and Tabriz as its centres. It controlled the farming and trade routes of Mesopotamia and Azerbaijan and fought for decades with the Muzaffarids, Timur and the Qara Qoyunlu; in the early fifteenth century it was displaced by the Qara Qoyunlu and Timurid power.

economy.zh: 经济以美索不达米亚的灌溉农业、手工业与过境贸易为基础，巴格达与桃里寺是商业与文化中心，丝绸、布匹与谷物是主要交换物，商路连接波斯、叙利亚与安纳托利亚。
economy.en: The economy rested on irrigated farming in Mesopotamia, crafts and transit trade, with Baghdad and Tabriz as centres of commerce and culture, silk, cloth and grain among the goods exchanged, and routes linking Persia, Syria and Anatolia.

culture.zh: 札剌亦儿宫廷是波斯文化与书籍艺术的赞助中心，细密画与书法成就突出，波斯语文学与史学在此发展，建筑与园林留下遗存，伊斯兰学术传统延续。
culture.en: The Jalayirid court was a centre of patronage for Persian culture and the book arts, its miniature painting and calligraphy outstanding, Persian literature and historiography developing there, its buildings and gardens surviving as remains, and Islamic scholarship continuing.

events.zh: 关键节点包括14世纪中叶王朝建立、14世纪末与帖木儿的战争、15世纪初的内部分裂，以及被黑羊王朝取代。
events.en: Key moments are the establishment of the dynasty in the mid-fourteenth century, its wars with Timur at the end of that century, internal division in the early fifteenth and its displacement by the Qara Qoyunlu.

value.zh: 以巴格达与桃里寺（大不里士）为都。
value.en: Its centres were Baghdad and Tabriz.
It was displaced by the Qara Qoyunlu in the early fifteenth century.

en: Namibia, officially the Republic of Namibia, as a country in Southern Africa
Its borders with the Atlantic Ocean to the west, Zambia and Angola to the north, Botswana to the east and South Africa to the south
zh: 纳米比亚正式称纳米比亚共和国，是南部非洲国家
西临大西洋，北接赞比亚与安哥拉，东连博茨瓦纳，南界南非

politics.zh: 纳米比亚共和国是南部非洲国家，西临大西洋，北接赞比亚与安哥拉，东连博茨瓦纳，南界南非，首都为温得和克。它原为德国殖民地，一战后由南非托管，1990年在长期武装斗争与国际压力下独立；独立后实行多党制与议会民主，是非洲政治较为稳定的国家之一。
politics.en: Namibia, officially the Republic of Namibia, is a country in Southern Africa, bordered by the Atlantic Ocean to the west, Zambia and Angola to the north, Botswana to the east and South Africa to the south, with Windhoek as its capital. A former German colony, it was administered by South Africa after the First World War and became independent in 1990 after a long armed struggle and international pressure; since independence it has been a multi-party parliamentary democracy and is among the more politically stable countries in Africa.

economy.zh: 经济以矿业、渔业、农业与旅游业为基础，铀、钻石与铜是重要出口品，纳米布沙漠与埃托沙国家公园支撑旅游业，畜牧业在内陆广泛分布。
economy.en: The economy rests on mining, fishing, farming and tourism, with uranium, diamonds and copper among the leading exports, the Namib desert and Etosha national park supporting tourism, and livestock raising widespread inland. Its sparsely populated interior is one of the driest regions on earth.

culture.zh: 纳米比亚有奥万博、赫雷罗、纳马、达马拉与桑人等族群，英语为官方语言而多种地方语言并用，辛巴族与桑人的传统生活方式受到关注，德国殖民时期的建筑与地名留下痕迹。
culture.en: Namibia is made up of Ovambo, Herero, Nama, Damara and San communities among others, English is official while many local languages are spoken, the traditional ways of the Himba and San attract attention, and German colonial buildings and place names remain.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1884年成为德国殖民地、1920年起由南非托管、1966年起武装斗争，以及1990年独立。
events.en: Key moments are its establishment as a German colony in 1884, the South African mandate from 1920, the armed struggle from 1966 and independence in 1990. Its constitution is widely regarded as one of Africa's most liberal.
